title: How to Deploy Your Cursor App to Production
summary: Cursor built your app in 45 minutes. Here's the fastest path to production — database, auth, hosting, and backend in 2 commands, not 8 separate services.
body_markdown: Vercel and Supabase are both excellent individual services. The difference is integration depth and agent control. With Blink, your Cursor agent has 80+ tools that can operate the full stack — not just deploy frontend code. There's also one bill, one dashboard, and no manual connection between services. See[best vibe coding tools](https://blink.new/blog/best-vibe-coding-tools) for a broader comparison.
